title: Going deeper: Predictable is not negotiable
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Use the voice safety needs, then teach, reconnect and preserve dignity.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: state what will happen next and follow through
principle: Make limits predictable without turning them into endless negotiation.
nextSentence: The reasonable limit remains. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can state what will happen next and follow through.
keyLearning: Make limits predictable without turning them into endless negotiation.
